editorial.blurb: This intimate Ethiopian gem delivers vibrant, flavorful dishes with attentive service and a cozy atmosphere that fills up fast.
editorial.insiderTip: Go for the vegetable samplers (like the Solo Veggie Sampler with 4 entrees) for excellent value and variety—they're generous portions that keep well as leftovers.

topDishes.note: Hot, spicy, and consistently praised for flavor
